articles.title: ONGC Q2 profit jumps 57% to Rs 15,489 crore on higher oil prices, rupee depreciation
articles.description: ONGC has reported a significant 57% increase in quarterly profit, reaching Rs 15,489 crore. The profit surge is attributed to higher oil and gas prices combined with rupee depreciation. Gross revenue also rose by 33% to Rs 43,875 crore during the July-September quarter. The company announced an interim dividend of Rs 8 per share, marking its highest-ever interim dividend.
